industry: Express air & ground parcel/courier logistics (primary business); temperature-controlled logistics for pharma/clinical shipments (secondary, specialized service)
size: ₹5,720 Cr FY25 revenue, ~8% of India's e-commerce shipments, DHL Group majority-owned (75% stake); new Bijwasan hub handles 550,000 shipments/day

facts.claim: Blue Dart Express was founded in November 1983 by Tushar Jani, Khushroo Dubash, and Clyde Cooper, and is headquartered in Mumbai.
facts.source_snippet: Blue Dart was founded by Tushar Jani (chairman) and his friends Khushroo Dubash and Clyde Cooper in November 1983... It is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

facts.claim: DHL Express (Singapore) Pte Ltd holds a 75% majority stake in Blue Dart Express (since November 2012), after originally acquiring 81.03% following a 2002 sales alliance and later investment.
facts.source_snippet: DHL Express (Singapore) Pte. LTD. acquired 81.03% stake in Blue Dart and currently holds 75% stake since 23rd November, 2012.

facts.claim: Blue Dart reported ₹5,720 crore revenue for FY25 (15% growth), and handles roughly 8% of India's e-commerce shipments as of 2024.
facts.source_snippet: Blue Dart Express Limited Clocks ₹ 5,720 Cr Revenue for FY25... Blue Dart is handling almost 8% of India's e-commerce shipments as of 2024.

facts.claim: In January 2025, Blue Dart opened India's largest low-emission integrated logistics center (2.5 lakh sq ft) at Bijwasan, Delhi, capable of handling 550,000 inbound and outbound shipments daily.
facts.source_snippet: opened the India's largest, low emission 2.5 lakh sq ft integrated logistics center at Bijwasan, Delhi on January 14, 2025... capacity to handle 550,000 inbound and outbound shipments [daily].

facts.claim: Blue Dart offers Temperature Controlled Logistics as a specialized service across three ranges -- Frozen (-20°C), Chilled (2-8°C), Ambient (15-25°C) -- for pharmaceuticals, clinical research organizations, and hospitals, covering items like blood, plasma, tissues, life-saving drugs, and diagnostics kits across 53 origin-destination pairs.
facts.source_snippet: Frozen: - 20°C, Chilled: 2 - 8°C, Ambient: 15 - 25°C... Blood, Plasma, Serum, Urine, Stool, Tissues and Cell Lines... Life-saving drugs... Diagnostics kits... 53 origin-destination pairs.

facts.claim: For temperature-controlled shipments, Blue Dart provides real-time online location tracking, but temperature logger graphs are only delivered to the shipper 24-48 hours after the shipment has already been delivered.
facts.source_snippet: Shipment-wise monitoring from pickup to delivery, including real-time online tracking facility... Temperature logger graphs to shipper in 24 - 48 hours after delivery of shipment.
